title: Robot and Mr. Mole

scenes.summary: A robot is introduced and described.
scenes.text: This is a robot. His nose is a cone. His legs are made of hose.
scenes.image_prompt: friendly blue robot with cone nose and hose legs standing on red ground, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: The robot falls into a hole.
scenes.image_prompt: cute robot falling into a dark hole with surprised expression, bright cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: The robot meets Mr. Mole in the hole.
scenes.text: Mr. Mole is in the hole.
scenes.image_prompt: small mole wearing glasses inside a cave with robot, warm light, cartoon children's illustration

scenes.summary: Mr. Mole offers help and gives instructions.
scenes.text: I can help, says Mr. Mole. Go up this rope, says Mr. Mole.
scenes.image_prompt: mole offering a rope to robot inside cave, glowing light bulb idea moment, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: The robot escapes and thanks Mr. Mole.
scenes.text: Thanks, Mr. Mole! says the robot.
scenes.image_prompt: robot happily climbing out and thanking mole, cheerful scene, bright colorful children's book illustration

story: This is a robot. His nose is a cone. His legs are made of hose. He falls into a hole. Mr. Mole is in the hole. I can help, says Mr. Mole. Go up this rope, says Mr. Mole. Thanks, Mr. Mole! says the robot.
